fact: On 10 April 2025 the High Court at Nairobi struck out a petition against the Huduma Bill 2021, finding the Bill lapsed when the 12th Parliament ended on 9 August 2022 and was never enacted.
title: Katiba Institute v Parliament of the Republic of Kenya & another [2025] KEHC 4609 (KLR)
publisher: Kenya Law Reports (High Court at Nairobi)
